calculation.expression: demean_cross_section(-sum(pct_change(close,1),3)) when lagged VIX one-day change exceeds its trailing 60-day 75th percentile; otherwise missing
calculation.description: A contrarian three-day return signal activated only after a lagged volatility shock, with daily cross-sectional median demeaning. The VIX is observation-only and is never traded.

validation.regime_notes: Daily result passes the benchmark gates but is sparse and regime-dependent: 2020-22 IC -0.036217 over 32 dates, 2023-24 +0.093299 over 29 dates, 2025-26 +0.082413 over 39 dates, and 2027 +0.113766 over 7 dates. Small cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
